plannedAsset.nextGate: Exact independent fixed-field copies across product, struct and contextual arrays; generic and method controls; exact lifetime counts; full current native suite and changed-source Windows Stage2/Stage3.

decision.reason: Native product types are interned before named call and binding types converge, leaving fixed-array fields untyped or incorrectly scalar. Revisit indexed products within the existing type fixed point. Aggregate value capture must also precede subsequent mutations; shared entry/function scheduling now preserves capture order and promotes child ordering identities to their enclosing aggregate to avoid self-dependencies.
